papers.title: Selective laser melting of TiB2/316L stainless steel composites: The roles of powder preparation and hot isostatic pressing post-treatment

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of California Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA 90095, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TiB2/316L不锈钢复合材料的SLM制备与HIP处理，完全不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力屏蔽等方向主题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, osseointegration, or any biomedical context; it focuses on powder preparation and HIP post-treatment of a non-biomedical composite.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究粉末制备和热等静压对SLM TiB2/316L复合材料的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同粉末混合方式制备SLM样品，并进行HIP后处理。
summary_zh.result: 优化粉末和HIP处理显著提高致密度和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织和力学测试验证工艺效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the roles of powder preparation and hot isostatic pressing post-treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted TiB2/316L stainless steel composites.
summary_en.method: Different powder blending routes were used to fabricate TiB2/316L composites via selective laser melting, followed by hot isostatic pressing.
summary_en.result: Hot isostatic pressing effectively eliminated pores and improved density, resulting in enhanced tensile strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through microstructural observation (SEM, EDS) and mechanical testing (tensile, hardness).

papers.title: APPLICATION OF SELECTIVE LASER MELTING IN MANUFACTURING OF FIXED DENTAL PROSTHESES
papers.abstract: The additive technologies characterize with the building of one layer at a time from a powder or liquid that is bonded by means of melting, fusing or polymerization. They offer a number of advantages over traditional methods: production of complex personalized objects without the need of complex machinery; manufacturing of parts with dense as well as the porous structure and predetermined surface roughness; controllable, easy and relatively quick process. The methods, mostly used in prosthetic dentistry, include stereolithography, selective laser sintering, and selective laser melting. The aim of the present paper is to review the features of the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process and the possibilities of its application for production of fixed dental prostheses. The features of the SLM process, the microstructure and mechanical characteristics of dental alloys as well as the properties of fixed dental prostheses, fabricated via SLM, were discussed. It was revealed that the SLM Co-Cr dental alloys possess higher mechanical and tribo-corrosion properties, comparatively good fitting ability and higher adhesion strength of the porcelain comparing to the cast alloys. All this is a good precondition for successful application of the SLM process in the production of fixed dental prostheses, mainly of frameworks for metal-ceramic and constructions covered with polymer/composite, intended for areas with high loading.

papers.title: Investigation of mechanical properties of nickel alloy products, obtained using various technological parameters of selective laser melting on 3D prototyping unit
papers.abstract: This work shows the optimization of the choice of technological modes of manufacturing of model samples from heat-resistant nickel alloys by selective laser melting on 3D prototyping unit, making possible the required structural behavior of material in the product. Experimental samples were manufactured from nickel alloy powders KhN62VMYuT (EP-708VD), KhN45MVTYuBR (EP-718) ((ХН62ВМЮТ (ЭП-708ВД), ХН45МВТЮБР (ЭП-718)) by selective laser melting technology on SLM 280 H unit with various technological modes. All technological modes of experimental modes manufacturing used the scanning algorythm – staggered filling, hatching range 0.12 μm, laser spot diameter 80 μm. The main technological parameters, defining the energy input density, varied for the sample manufacturing: power of laser irradiation (245–305 W) and scanning rate (605–1005 m/s), energy input density (0.24–0.50 J/m). Mechanical characteristics of experimental samples during the tension on universal testing machine UTS-100 at the room temperature were defined. The destruction nature for samples, manufactured from the nickel alloy KhN62VMYuT (EP-708VD), is fragile, and there is almost no material plasticity. Maximal durability properties are reached with the energy input density in the range of 0.30–0.35 J/m. Maximal durability properties of experimental samples from nickel alloy KhN45MVTYuBR (EP-718) are reached with the energy input density in the range of 0.30–0.40 J/m. The energy density input in the powder melting zone, is the basic factor, influencing on the durability properties of mateiral.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基合金的SLM工艺参数优化，完全不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或骨整合等本方向核心内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper lacks any biomedical context, porous structure design, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, surface morphology, or osseointegration assessment relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化选区激光熔化镍基合金的工艺参数以提高力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率和扫描速率制备样品，进行拉伸测试。
summary_zh.result: 确定了获得最佳抗拉强度的能量密度范围（0.30-0.40 J/m）。
summary_zh.validation: 使用万能试验机进行室温拉伸测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting process parameters for heat-resistant nickel alloys to achieve desired mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Experimental samples were fabricated with varying laser power (245–305 W) and scanning rate (605–1005 mm/s), and tensile tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: Maximum tensile strength was achieved at energy densities of 0.30–0.35 J/m for KhN62VMYuT and 0.30–0.40 J/m for KhN45MVTYuBR alloys.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated by uniaxial tensile testing on a universal testing machine at room temperature.
